rules.roth: Highest-growth convictions, REITs, and high-yield payers — shelter what is taxed hardest.
rules.taxable: Broad-market index ETFs and anything you may need before 59.5.

roth.name: EIX
roth.reason: 5.1% yield is taxed every year in a taxable account whether or not you sell — there is no deferral. Note this overrides the 'boring goes taxable' instinct: the criterion is taxability, not volatility.

roth.name: INVH
roth.reason: REIT — distributions are largely non-qualified and taxed as ordinary income, making this the most tax-inefficient asset class you hold. Sheltering it is worth more than sheltering an equivalent amount of growth stock.

roth.name: PAYX
roth.reason: 4.0% yield is taxed every year in a taxable account whether or not you sell — there is no deferral. Note this overrides the 'boring goes taxable' instinct: the criterion is taxability, not volatility.
